scope.summary: Author the canonical gradient primitive StudioGradient (schema id hsk.studio.gradient@1): a multi-stop model with per-stop color (StudioColorProfile/StudioSwatch) and opacity, editable midpoint/skew, and geometry. Geometries: linear (axis with angle), radial (center+radius with aspect ratio), elliptical/conical (elliptical radial + angular sweep), freeform (free-placed color points or lines inside a shape, per-point spread/opacity — points and lines modes), mesh (editable mesh grid interpolating color between mesh points with per-point transparency; convertible from a gradient), bitmap (image-based fill with editable placement). Reference canonical StudioGradient from MT-002; discriminate by geometry, never separate primitives.
acceptance_criteria: StudioGradient@1 multi-stop + all geometries; profile/swatch stop colors; single primitive by geometry; no fork
expected_tests: test: StudioGradient@1 multi-stop (profile/swatch color + opacity, midpoint/skew) with geometry {linear,radial,elliptical,conical,freeform,mesh,bitmap} round-trips
argus: gradient tool edits stops on canvas

risk_if_missed: No gradient primitive; fills forked; gradient workflows unmet.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
